headline.text: L2 ML3 found foreign product in ingredient super sacks for the *second consecutive night* — cherry kisses tonight, pretzels yesterday.

summary: Two foreign-material incidents in 24 hours at L2: cherry kisses in ML3 super sacks (second night in a row), and a vape device found charging on L1 S3 production floor. One quality hold resolved same-shift: L3 MFM underweight pouches traced to caramel piece-count variation. Multiple sanitation gaps flagged across L1 and L2.

holds.title: MFM underweight pouch hold
holds.summary: Pouches rejected for low weight; 1 bin filled in 30 minutes with caramels showing 8-10 piece counts (target likely 9); left side of dual pouch underweight while right side in spec.
holds.status: Resolved on shift — Shawn Jewkes adjusted Yamato settings, line restarted at 14:10 same day.

food_safety.title: Vape device found on production floor
food_safety.summary: Personal vape device discovered charging on computer desk near S3 enrober; no ownership claimed by second-shift team.
food_safety.status: Resolved — device removed; Angelica Perez and Dakota Adair reminded all shifts that vape devices prohibited in production areas.

food_safety.title: Foreign product in ingredient super sacks
food_safety.summary: Cherry kisses found inside super sacks on ML3 third shift — second consecutive night of foreign product contamination (pretzels found previous night).
food_safety.status: Open, documented by Zack Kurtz with Jose, Alan, Hervin tagged; root cause and supplier notification status unknown at window close.

quality.title: FFS box label mismatch guidance requested
quality.summary: Zack Kurtz raised concern that boxes with mismatched product labels create confusion and identification errors; asked for consistent SOP (marked out, plain label, or correct label).
quality.status: Open — Hervin and Alan tagged for follow-up; interim action: EEs marking out existing labels to eliminate confusion.

sanitation.title: ML2 vacuum elbow/splitter full of chocolate
sanitation.summary: Vacuum transfer system for belt/spacer found full of chocolate in 90° elbow and filter canister; filter reinstalled without cleaning top of canister; mixed milk and white chocolate visible.
sanitation.status: Resolved — Dave Ruff cleaned elbow and filter; established daily 20-min clean cadence plus deep clean Fridays.

sanitation.title: S3 trash area left very messy
sanitation.summary: Trash bins left full; corner-board cutting crew did not clean area; Katya Farnsworth posted photo at shift start.
sanitation.status: Open — Victor Romero requested cleanup and coaching for corner-board crew.

sanitation.title: Dishwashing area cleanup opportunities
sanitation.summary: Katya Farnsworth posted photos of dishwashing areas showing sanitation gaps requiring attention.
sanitation.status: Open — photos posted for first-shift follow-up.

sanitation.title: S2 Conbar cleanup opportunities
sanitation.summary: Katya Farnsworth posted photos of S2 Conbar area showing sanitation gaps.
sanitation.status: Open — photos posted for first-shift follow-up.

sanitation.title: ML4 mold magazine chocolate buildup
sanitation.summary: Four silicone mold-holders in magazine had chocolate buildup causing molds to slide and jam sideways; Victor and maintenance cleaned buildup.
sanitation.status: Resolved — buildup removed, molds tracking correctly.
